title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Composter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Composter. Device that performs the task of composting. Subclass of s4envi:WasteTreatmentDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.14); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes are inherited, not repeated here. Base class for s4envi:CompostBin, s4envi:VermicompostBin and s4envi:Windrow.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Composter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
